pages.text: Tom's Simple Storage allows you to connect multiple chests together in one big inventory, and access it through a terminal. First you'll need to craft a Storage Terminal
This is what gives you, your access to the chest array. It can later be upgraded to a crafting terminal, which implements a crafting table within the UI.

You'll also need an Inventory Connector. This is what you'll need to place between your chests / barrels and the Terminal, this connects the chests, barrels and other storage blocks together into one inventory.
You can also connect multiple inventories together using either Inventory Trims or Inventory Cables.
Sophisticated Storage can further enhance your storage by allowing for upgradable chests and barrels, much like the backpacks.

You can increase the inventory size of the storage chests with Iron, Gold, Diamond and Netherite upgrades. There is a range of other upgrades too, such as the stack upgrade, compacting upgrade, void upgrade and more!

Once the Wither has been defeated, you can further enhance your storage with Wireless Terminals. Place a Level 1-3 Beacon within 8 blocks of the Terminal and right click the Terminal with a Wireless Transmitter.

You can now access your storage from ~16 blocks away. You can further upgrade this with an Advanced Wireless Terminal and a level 4 beacon. This will allow you to access your storage system from any dimension!
